patch.value: Same-day ordinal npm publish requires an explicit stable dist-tag

The release workflow accepts calendar follow-up versions such as 2026.7.24-2, but npm 11 refuses to publish any hyphenated semver without --tag. Select the stable dist-tag explicitly for every supported calendar version, prove the workflow contract, and recover the failed same-day release without manual npm publication.
Push supported tag v2026.7.24-2 and inspect Release run 30077790348 Publish to npm.
Tag-triggered Release publishes supported same-day ordinal versions and updates the stable npm channel.
npm publish exits 1: You must specify a tag using --tag when publishing a prerelease version.
